messages:
maya: Heads-up — I want to change the SIEM export retention policy for partner investigation buckets. Proposal: default export TTL 30d (was 90d). Need PB: RBAC change to restrict who can request exports, and a KMS unwrap / JIT key access flow. cc @devon @keith
ash: Quick Q — what's driving 30d specifically? cost or data minimization for partners?
devon: Mix of both. Partners asked for shorter residency by default; also reduces blast radius for accidental exposures. Concern: forensics/legal might need longer in some incidents. We need an approved exception flow and audit trail.
keith: Legal input: 30d ok for routine exports. But we must support a documented "legal hold" extension with approvals and immutable audit. We also need a retention justification field on the request.
maya: Agreed. Thinking: request form includes scope, justification, retention_end (auto-calc 30d default), owner, approver. Exemptions -> legal review checkbox that triggers manual approval and audit tag.
ash: On RBAC side: propose new role `siem_export_requester` (can open requests) and `siem_export_approver` (can approve), `siem_export_executor` (can kick off bucket + KMS unwrap). PR will whitelist service accounts for `executor`.
devon: KMS: no plaintext key material in docs. Use ephemeral KMS Decrypt grants via a proxy service that issues a short-lived unseal token. Flow: approver triggers decrypt, proxy calls KMS using CMK with condition: request_id in encryption_context and TTL 15m. All decrypt events logged to CloudTrail + SIEM event with request_id.
keith: Need to ensure CMK policy requires `encryption_context.request_id` and that CMK logs include request_id. Also add policy to prevent unwrap unless `approved=true` tag in request system.
maya: Drafted a ticket template (below) — please eyeball.
```
- request_id: auto
- requester: (org/name + email)
- scope: list of index names and time ranges
- justification: free text (why export needed)
- retention_days: default 30 (must be <= 365, or choose 'legal_hold')
- approver: security oncall / legal if flagged
- kms_cmk: CMK-id (readonly)
- export_bucket_ttl: 30d lifecycle rule
- audit_links: links to PR / Slack thread
```
ash: LGTM. Add a checkbox `contains_pii` and `requires_dlp_scrub` so we can gate DLP pipeline.
devon: Also embed a minimal CLI snippet for on-demand exports (wrapped behind service auth):
```bash
# request export
redwood-siem export create --scope "index:auth*;from:2026-03-01;to:2026-03-05" \\  --retention 30 --justification "partner triage" --requester maya@redwood.ai
```
keith: Procedural: any request flagged `legal_hold` requires ELA (legal) + security approver. Do not allow automated KMS unwrap for those.
security-bot: ticket created: SEC-2026-7891 — status: triage. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-7891 :white_check_mark:
maya: cool, thanks. Action items: 1) ash — open RBAC PR for new roles 2) devon — draft KMS proxy policy + CloudTrail logging snippet 3) keith — write legal hold process and exception checklist 4) maya — publish request template + add DLP checkbox. Will sync in tomorrow's 11:00 sync. :thumbsup:
